horoscopes.horoscope: You may find yourself in a precarious position today, says Ganesha. You may feel challenged and swim against the current, which will be counterproductive. Nothing may seem to work out. Taking a break will ease the stress at such a time. A sweet time is ahead with your loved one. You may tend to experiment something new in romance tonight. After all, you will exchange sweet notes with your lover, foresees Ganesha. You may forge a close relationship this wonderful evening. You will remain fit and fine, on this fabulous day. Moreover, your determination and patience shall enable you to easily manage anything and everything. Look forward to receive the fruits of your labour, in cash as well as in kind. A favourable day for money matters is on the cards. You shall earn good money using your vast experience. The time is also auspicious to earn an extra buck using your myriad talents. Ganesha predicts a successful day for you. You realise today that time is money, and act accordingly. Since you are full of renewed energy to prove yourself, you will successfully finish all tasks assigned to you.

Almost as if crafted by Cervantes himself, you might wake up today feeling passionate and quixotic. Make up and make overs may be on the cards as you will have the urge to be groomed. Once you are done without yourself, you will shower others with attention, says Ganesha. You will be calm and comfortable while spending time with your lover. You will change your stance in love life and try to woo your partner in a more creative way, feels Ganesha. A long-term relationship is on the cards, foresees Ganesha. Your agenda for the day will be health and well-being. It goes without saying that you will chalk out a fitness plan and immediately start exercising. To maintain your energy level and stay healthy, avoid junk food and relax in the evening. You are likely to get yourself an image make-over today. But, you are not likely to spend a bomb on it. You will bargain hard to get the best deals, and thus save a sizable amount of money. Financial matters of the company will concern you today. Your energy is just about right to begin working on new investment projects. Meetings involving discussions on finance will prove to be favourable for you. You may make some important decisions regarding upcoming projects.

Today may not be very meaningful and productive for you, though you will get to spend plenty of quality time with yourself in the afternoon, which may not necessarily be to your liking. By evening, you may feel a little extra sensitive. A lonely day, or as an optimist would put it, you’ve got the whole day to yourself; it could have been worse (For instance, a day alone with your nagging mother-in-law!). You are energetic and confident in your commitment. You may feel satisfied with the sacrifices you have made to make the relationship work. You will enjoy a blissful time with your partner. Today you need to be selective in what you do. Do only those tasks which you feel will yield results. You need to listen to advice given by people, else you will end up working on things in totally wrong direction. Money may be spent behind health issues so you are advised to be very cautious about health and related matters. Today, you should eat outside food, as it might affect your health adversely. You will not be having a perfect day today. After all, nobody is perfect. However, Ganesha feels that your efforts need to be channelized in the right direction. You will be able to keep the technical errors at bay only if you put your logical abilities to optimum use.

With Ganesha’s grace, whatever you think or peruse will be successful. Students will excel and finish pending work. You can display your imagination excellently. In short, a day of happiness and variety. The level of your emotional satisfaction will keep you away from all worries. You will be responsible for all the domestic works though you will prioritize your romance, feels Ganesha. Your sense of humor will play an important role in getting closer to your partner. Today your sincere and dedicated efforts will be noticed by your superiors in workplace. Look forward to receiving the fruits of your hard labour. Feeling motivated and overjoyed, you will throw a party at the end of this superb day. Today is going to be a routine day for financial matters wherein monetary gains are not very visible, unless you put in efforts. In other words, you shall not be lucky in financial matters. You want to involve your teams in the decision making. It’s the right day to synchronise the tasks of your team members through meetings or lectures. Your enthusiasm and devotion towards work will reward you in future, foresees Ganesha.

When it comes to maintaining a balance in any relationship, you set an example for others to follow. It is like an inner light guides you towards joyful coexistence, though, at times, it may entail making certain acts of sacrifice, says Ganesha. You may choose to lose an argument in order to win hearts. Just remember that losing a battle is sometimes the only way to win the war. Keep your language short and sweet on this wonderful day. Lucky Colour Deep Bright Yellow The strict efforts may not bear fruit in persuading your partner. He or she may feel that you don’t take care of your duties and responsibilities. A creative approach may melt the mood of your loved one, feels Ganesha. Try to listen to his or her heart, suggests Ganesha. In the pink of health, you will invest your energy to accomplish difficult assignments and resolve complicated issues, both in the professional and personal sphere. But, don’t waste your precious time after fruitless activities. Avoid conflicts with seniors in your office. Today you need to take up more assignments to earn some extra money. Short term benefits as are not on, but be patient. Those dealing in stock market may not be very happy with circumstances. A pleasant day at work today says Ganesha. You will be in such a serious mood today that you will not allow any mistakes. Since you will concentrate completely on work, you will see your career grow in leaps and bounds, says Ganesha.

Avoid all kinds of prejudice and do not allow intolerance to enter your mind today, advises Ganesha. In all likelihood, you will look around yourself in search of love and affection. You will do well to keep negativity at bay as otherwise it may cow you down. Ganesha suggests that you marshal all your courage to live as per your convictions. Ganesha gives you the green signal if you are planning for a small trip with your family or sweetheart. Travel is not foreseen in near future but planning in advance can certainly help you enjoy the trip. Be prepared for a romantic outing, inspires Ganesha. Check your temper, and adopt a pragmatic approach, says Ganesha. This will enable you to take right decisions and sail smoothly across rough waters. Also take a break to replenish your energy. Have dinner with family at your favourite restaurant. Ganesha feels that today you shall be very pragmatic in matters of finances and will not be spending any money thoughtlessly. If you wish to take decision regarding investments, today is a lucky day. You will hit the nails on the head, foresees Ganesha. Your practical approach or realistic attitude will help you finish off your work on time today. Fast and smooth work will keep you ahead of the competition. You will plan upcoming projects in advance, feels Ganesha.

Ganesha says today will be an auspicious day for starting any new work. In the office you will be assigned new positions and you shall excel in the same. Whatever work is undertaken by you will see you attain success in it. Today is a lucky day for you Ganesha says. You are in your best mood today. It’s the best day to propose your sweetheart. It’s the time to go down with your knee and gift the most precious thing to your loved one. You will allure your partner and will enjoy having a steamy time together. On this dull day, do not tax your mind and body. The time has come to take a holiday and relax your tired brain and muscles. Take sufficient rest, else it may take a long time to regain peak fitness. The day is not very favourable for you in financial matters. Ganesha advises you not to invest you funds aggressively. Finances are likely to make you worried because long-term gains are immediately evident. You will be at your creative best, foresees Ganesha. With your wit and creative instincts in top gear, you will have a blast flooring your colleagues and bosses in office. Your work will reflect your innovative ideas and you will be satisfied with your progress.

Today, there may come up situations which may test your patience, predicts Ganesha. However, it would be wise to sit and sort out all the differences with your colleagues or family members or your partner. Giving your loved one some space will add a relief to your love life. Avoid running into confrontations. Talk to your partner, listen to his or her advice and sort out any issues immediately, suggests Ganesha. Strike the right balance between your personala and professional life. You were spending lots of time in your workplace, and hence devoted less time for your family. You may be exhausted – mentally and physically. Take a break – now! Today you will willingly spend money on your life-partner or beloved. You may also wish to spend money to flaunt yourself in the society, to show just how financially stable you are. An average day for you, says Ganesha. At the workplace, important meetings should go well. You need to be extra alert and maintain your dignity. Plan and carefully revise your schedule, advises Ganesha.

It’s time for invitations and grooving all night long. And even eat like a glutton. But, for a change you are not on a mood to party, though it is unlike you. You reject the idea of socialising and hitting the dance floor. And your friends do not like your changed avatar, says Ganesha. You may tend to ignore your sweetheart. Keeping your secret will never entice your partner. Plan a evening and spend some time together. Feel confident while expressing love to your future husband or wife, suggests Ganesha. Give top priority to yourself – everyone and everything should take a back-seat today. It is high time you devoted time to recharge your drained batteries. Your tired mind also needs a break from the humdrum routine. Relax and just chill. Ganesha feels that you need to review your balance-sheet objectively if you want to work on your finances; you will know where you have gone wrong and be able to make amends. Today’s planetary energies do not make for a great day. You may not be confident or remain calm. You need to be more than active and energetic at your workplace. To boost your confidence, do yoga and meditation daily, suggests Ganesha.

You’ll kick start the day in high spirit which will take everyone by surprise. You will shift gears at work so that you can perform more efficiently and productively. Such a change will boost your confidence as you will see the positive results for yourself. Most of the day, you will work like a busy bee, but at the end you will listen to music or be with your friends to relax your mind, foretells Ganesha. You will be happy to see yourself creative on the love front, you partner will be more than impressed with you. With your creative spirits, you will be able to embark on a new destination, reveals Ganesha. A satisfied evening is on the cards. Work hard – but not at the cost of your health. Become pragmatic and take good care of your wellness. Also think positively and try to stay cheerful. This will boost your happiness quotient, which shall automatically improve your health. You shall be very mentally active today and more than willing to learn new things. You need learn more about investment and speculation. Or, you can invest money behind some creative pursuit. Your professional life may be flooded with opportunities today, foresees Ganesha. Your advice or decision will reap fruitful results. Lucrative profit making opportunities, incentives and perks are promised, provided you work hard.

Are you facing a roadblock in your path? Make a minor change in your route, you will find a smooth and clear road once again, advises Ganesha. The efforts you have made in the past will come to fruition, today. Don’t get satisfied with your current achievements, you still have a long way to keep working hard. Lucky Colour Light Electric Blue You might reach home early to spend some quality time with your family. You will feel the best on the arm of your sweetheart. Preparing a delicious cuisine together or discussing a lifestyle matters will occupy your minds tonight, feels Ganesha. Exhausted due to your hectic and humdrum routine, you surely need a holiday. After completing your urgent work, make sure you relax to replenish your drained energy. Meditation and yoga will help to increase your endurance and provide inner peace. Beware against purchasing of electronic gadgets or things that have just been introduced into the market. Such investments will give you only a transient pleasure, so better keep temptations at bay. Ganesha finds you pondering over some work-related matters today. Anyway, it is high time that you identify your professional shortcomings. You will be able to replicate your past success if you are fully committed, feels Ganesha.

Do not commit yourself to any large investments today. It is best to avoid speculative activities. For those who have a job, the co-operation of your colleagues will help you progress, says Ganesha. You may behave with your lover as if you are in Utopia. Your actions and behavior will leave your partner dazed. Ganesha says that you need to be a realistic too in order to fulfill your lover’s needs. Overall health will be good. Decision making, particularly regarding financial matters shall be your agenda for today. You may have to tackle some mind boggling issues, yet success will surely come your way. Party with dear ones is on the cards. Ganesha feels that today you can plan to visit some surrounding areas. Or, maybe you can go for long road trip to get some fresh air. Keep in mind that every investment has some return, whether you realise it or not. Changes in your work style will prove to be very useful for you and you might also find a considerable boost in your creative energy. You innovative efforts will fetch some profitable results for your company, foresees Ganesha.
